description: Suchotnik, a desiccated husk of a man, hunched forward in a wide crouching stance, knees bent, both bony legs and bare feet visible, long arms hanging forward with clawed bony fingers, a big skull-like head with empty eye sockets glowing faintly red, cracked skin like dry clay, dust falling from its joints, a broad silhouette filling the whole picture from edge to edge like a large creature, few big readable shapes, menacing, full body, three-quarter view

references.usage: the creature's look chosen by the author: the same gaunt cracked husk, its big skull-like head, face and colours, but drawn whole down to both feet, hunched so that it fills the whole picture
